entities.summary: Theophilanthropy was a secular religion established in France during the later stages of the French Revolution. It aimed to provide a state-sponsored alternative to both established Christianity and the atheistic Cult of Reason. Based on deistic beliefs in the existence of God and the immortality of the soul, its core tenets were the love of God and the love of one's fellow man.
